output.obligation: Identify the person who is the founder of a company whose online video games division released a video game between 2000 and 2010 that was considered one of the top-earning games of all time until at least 2019, who graduated from a university founded between 1930 and 1970, and who, with their spouse (who had no children from the marriage up to 2019), made a foundational gift for the construction of a building that was part of a larger complex and was scheduled to open between 2018 and 2021 as of 2019.
